overview: The Committee of the Whole conducted its fifth preliminary budget hearing for fiscal year 2027, reviewing several city departments and commissions. The meeting featured significant debate regarding Law Department litigation costs and the vacancy of the City Solicitor position.

items.title: Medford Community Media Budget
items.summary: Director Kevin Harrington presented a budget increase to fund a third full-time production coordinator and discussed a plan to move PEG fees into a dedicated special revenue fund.

items.title: Health, Human Services, and Emergency Management Budget
items.summary: Director MaryAnn O'Connor reviewed the department's $1.25 million in grant funding and high inspection volume, and the council supported her request to rename the department to Health and Human Services.

items.title: Planning, Development, and Sustainability Budget
items.summary: Director Alicia Hunt outlined economic development goals, climate resiliency grants, and the implementation of a citywide wayfinding study.

items.title: Associated Commissions and Boards
items.summary: The committee reviewed routine budgets for multiple boards, including a $700 increase for the Bicycle Commission and an increase in Community Development Board stipends to align with the Board of Appeals.

items.title: License and Hormel Commissions
items.summary: The committee reviewed the License Commission budget, which saw a reduction due to redundancy, and the Hormel Commission budget, which remained flat.

items.title: Executive Department Budget
items.summary: Chief of Staff Nina Nazarian detailed shifts in funding for communications and community affairs positions to ARPA and casino funds, while councilors expressed frustration with the overall budget timeline.

items.title: Law Department Budget
items.summary: The council debated the legal budget, with members proposing to eliminate the City Solicitor's salary and outside legal fees due to the six-month vacancy in the position and a lack of transparency regarding litigation strategy.
